text: Prior to the breakthrough experiments, 0.3 g of activated 1 adsorbent was filled into the customized adsorption column (7.0 mm I.D. and 250 mm in length); glass wool was used to plug the two ends of the column. Then, the column was in situ heated at a temperature of 373 K for 12 h with a helium flow (5 sccm) to remove the adsorbed gas impurities. After the system was stabilized, the device was cooled to 298 K, and the gas mixtures of C3H6/C3H8/He (30/30/40, v/v/v) were introduced into the pipeline. The gas mixtures were passed through the column at a flow rate of 2 sccm and detected through GC.
